description: A light wooden tabletop is in front with several piles of playing cards: a small face-up cluster near the top center, a loose stack on the right edge, and a thicker pile near the lower right. The left hand holds a single face-down card near the center, then flips and slides it forward to place it face-up as the 9 of spades; the right hand stays mostly still, hovering above the table without touching the cards.
